Your study resources.

Download editable Word practice packs, printable PDFs and a teaching PowerPoint for each learning unit. Use the same exercise numbers to match questions with answers.

Practice question and answer packs

229 exercises: 110 quiz questions, 22 debugging challenges, 44 lesson tasks and 53 task-library exercises. Includes arrays, parallel arrays, IF/ELSE and SWITCH/CASE.

Download questions PDF

These are open revision downloads. Answer packs are available directly. If you want to test yourself first, choose Questions only. Written solutions are examples and other correct approaches may exist.

Learning unit slides

Editable PowerPoint (.pptx)

The detailed decks cover all lesson theory in each unit, definitions before use, declared variables, numbered pseudocode walkthroughs, step-by-step traces and worked exercise solutions. Each unit also has a short 10-slide revision deck with key definitions, worked examples, practice answers and common mistakes. Unit 2 includes IF/ELSE and SWITCH/CASE. Unit 3 includes single and two-dimensional arrays as well as parallel arrays.
